subject: 用fzero解積分式，但積分式有兩個變數

messages.author: ca8f3ee330df3402
messages.subject: 用fzero解積分式，但積分式有兩個變數
parts:
大家好喔，
想請問一個問題是，在R，function的表達式，如果有兩個變數，要怎麼寫成code呢?

我的code

#---time start---#
ptm <- proc.time()

library(pracma)

U = 14; L = 7; d = (U-L)/2;
T = ( 3*U+L )/(3+1); #  by 3Du = Dl 的關係
Du = U-T; Dl = T - L; d_star = min(Du,Dl);
du = d/Du; dl = d/Dl;
alpha = 0.05;
aLe = 0.05; # 非對稱的Le
n = 100;

ksi_given = -3;

if (ksi_given <= 0){
  sigma = fzero(function(x) aLe - (x^2)*(  (dl^2*ksi_given^2+1)/d_star^2  ), c(0,0.5) )$x ;
  mu = ksi_given*sigma + T;
  B = n*(  (dl*ksi_given)^2 + 1  )/aLe;
  C = (dl*ksi_given)^2/(d_star/sigma)^2 + 1/(d_star/sigma)^2;
  b = d_star/sigma;
}else{
  sigma = fzero(function(x) aLe - (x^2)*(  (du^2*ksi_given^2+1)/d_star^2  ), c(0,0.5) )$x ;
  mu = ksi_given*sigma + T;
  B = (   n*(  (du*ksi_given)^2 + 1  )   )/aLe;
  C = (du*ksi_given)^2/(d_star/sigma)^2 + 1/(d_star/sigma)^2;
  b = d_star/sigma;
}




fun = function(ca,y) { pchisq( B*ca-y, n-1)* ( 1/ (2*sqrt(y)) )* (   (dl^-1)*normpdf( (dl^-1)*sqrt(y) + sqrt(n*ksi_given) ) + (du^-1)*normpdf( (du^-1)*sqrt(y) - sqrt(n*ksi_given) )    ) };

fun2 = function(ca)  alpha - integrate(fun(ca,y),lower = 0.0001,upper = B*ca);

c = linspace(1e-4,0.1,100);
for (i in 1:numel(c)){
  fc(i) = fun2(c(i));
}

plot(c,fc)


ca = fzero(function(ca) fun2, aLe);


R回傳的訊息:
> source('C:/Users/user/Desktop/晁真_meeting/thesis_aLe_Exact_2.R')
Error in pchisq(B * ca - y, n - 1) : object 'y' not found

謝謝!

messages.subject: Re: 用fzero解積分式，但積分式有兩個變數
parts:
Hi 布萊迪,

程式中, fc[i] = fun2(c[i])  ,其中 fun2函數包括 integrate(fun(ca,y), ...) integrate函數只提供單一變數之積分值, 但程式碼沒有提供y值, 因此須確認y值, 如此程式應可執行.
